title: AI Tools
symptomCheckerDesc: Enter your symptoms to get possible diagnoses
disclaimer: This tool is for informational purposes only. Always consult a healthcare professional.
pneumoniaSubtitle: Upload a chest X-ray image for AI-assisted pneumonia screening
pneumoniaDisclaimer: AI-assisted screening only. Not a final diagnosis. Final clinical decision must be made by a qualified physician.
pneumoniaFileHelp: Supported: JPG, PNG. Max size: 10 MB.
pneumoniaEmpty: Upload an X-ray image to start analysis
pneumoniaFileTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum 10 MB.
pneumoniaInvalidType: Invalid file type. Use JPG or PNG.
positiveExplanation: Pneumonia pattern detected above the clinical threshold.
negativeExplanation: No pneumonia pattern exceeded the clinical threshold.
probabilityBelowThreshold: {{prob}}% is below the {{threshold}}% threshold, so the AI screening classification is Negative.
probabilityAboveThreshold: {{prob}}% exceeds the {{threshold}}% threshold, indicating a positive screening result.
recommendationPositive: Review chest X-ray with clinical symptoms. Radiologist or physician evaluation is recommended.
recommendationNegative: If symptoms persist, clinical evaluation is still recommended regardless of screening result.
recommendationElevated: Probability is elevated but below the positive threshold. Consider clinical review given the moderate-to-high probability.
gradcamInterpretationWarning: Grad-CAM is an interpretability aid showing regions that influenced the model. It does not prove disease location. Red/yellow = higher influence. Blue = lower influence.
confidenceNote: Confidence is a model score reflecting distance from the decision boundary. It is not clinical certainty.
finalClinicalDisclaimer: This AI result is for screening support only. It is not a final diagnosis. Final clinical decisions must be made by qualified healthcare professionals.
